page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 server instance running under KVM hypervisor virtualization. It is configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of RAM, yielding a ratio of 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no attached local storage and operates without dedicated GPU acceleration. Standard CPU extensions, including vector processing sets such as AVX/AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators like AES, are not reported as enabled on this hardware profile.

Benchmark performance metrics for the ecs.s2.large instance are unavailable. Operationally, the instance relies entirely on network-attached block storage solutions due to the lack of local disk storage. The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio prioritizes core availability over memory capacity, while the absence of hardware cryptographic flags indicates processing reliance on standard x86 instruction paths.

From an architectural perspective, the ecs.s2.large provides a lightweight dedicated vCPU footprint. Without local storage or hardware accelerators, cost efficiency centers on baseline compute hosting, small microservices, internal staging environments, and non-intensive background utility tasks requiring fixed compute allocations without large memory demands.
